sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形节目。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: People all over the world are flirting with an idea called basic income.
sentences.zh: 全世界的人们都在热议一个名为“基本收入”的概念。

sentences.en: Basic income.
sentences.zh: 基本收入。

sentences.en: Basic income.
sentences.zh: 基本收入。

sentences.en: Basic income for all.
sentences.zh: 全民基本收入。

sentences.en: The idea behind the basic income is that
sentences.zh: 基本收入背后的理念是

sentences.en: each citizen receives a payment every month
sentences.zh: 每个公民每个月都能收到一笔款项

sentences.en: as a right without conditions and paid individually.
sentences.zh: 作为一项无条件、按个人发放的权利。

sentences.en: Basic income.
sentences.zh: 基本收入。

sentences.en: Also known as universal basic income or unconditional basic income, or UBI.
sentences.zh: 也被称为全民基本收入或无条件基本收入，即 UBI。

sentences.en: That's producer Avery Truffelman.
sentences.zh: 这是制作人埃弗里·特罗费尔曼。

sentences.en: Very, very roughly defined universal basic income
sentences.zh: 非常非常粗略地定义，全民基本收入

sentences.en: is this idea that a government would pay all their citizens.
sentences.zh: 就是指政府向所有公民支付款项的想法。

sentences.en: And everyone would get a flat sum of money every month
sentences.zh: 每个人每个月都会得到一笔固定金额的钱

sentences.en: to cover their basic needs, whether or not they have a job.
sentences.zh: 来满足他们的基本需求，无论他们是否有工作。

sentences.en: And this money would be no strings attached, with no conditions,
sentences.zh: 而且这笔钱没有任何附加条件，毫无限制，

sentences.en: and this would hopefully remove any stigma from receiving it.
sentences.zh: 希望这能消除领取它的任何耻辱感。

sentences.en: It's free money, basically.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这就是白给的钱。

sentences.en: It's free money.
sentences.zh: 这就是白给的钱。

sentences.en: The logic behind it is this.
sentences.zh: 它背后的逻辑是这样的。

sentences.en: A lot of jobs don't pay enough money for people to even make rent or buy groceries.
sentences.zh: 很多工作的薪水甚至不够人们支付房租或买杂货。

sentences.en: You can work full-time and still be below the poverty line.
sentences.zh: 你可能全职工作，却依然处于贫困线以下。

sentences.en: So it's easy to understand why people on the left would advocate for a guaranteed income.
sentences.zh: 所以很容易理解为什么左翼人士会主张保障收入。

sentences.en: But also, a version of this concept is popular in libertarian circles.
sentences.zh: 但同时，这一概念的某种变体在自由意志主义圈子里也很受欢迎。

sentences.en: They see basic income as a way to shrink the welfare state.
sentences.zh: 他们将基本收入视为缩减福利国家规模的一种方式。

sentences.en: For example, you could take away food stamps, Medicare, and housing subsidies,
sentences.zh: 例如，你可以取消食品券、医疗保险和住房补贴，

sentences.en: and replace all of it with one flat sum.
sentences.zh: 并将所有这些替换为一笔固定的总额。

sentences.en: People in tech are also interested in the concept of basic income,
sentences.zh: 科技界也对基本收入的概念感兴趣，

sentences.en: and they feel a certain urgency about it.
sentences.zh: 他们对此有一种紧迫感。

sentences.en: Robots are coming for our jobs, they say.
sentences.zh: 他们说，机器人正向我们的工作袭来。

sentences.en: And basic income is the best way for humans to maintain a decent lifestyle
sentences.zh: 而基本收入是人类维持体面生活方式的最佳途径，

sentences.en: when our labor is increasingly obsolete.
sentences.zh: 当我们的劳动力日益变得过时的时候。

sentences.en: Our generation is going to have to deal with tens of millions of jobs
sentences.zh: 我们这一代人将不得不应对数千万个工作岗位

sentences.en: replaced by automation, like self-driving cars and trucks.
sentences.zh: 被自动化取代的情况，比如自动驾驶汽车和卡车。

sentences.en: But we have the potential to do so much more than that.
sentences.zh: 但我们有潜力做得更多。

sentences.en: That's Mark Zuckerberg giving a commencement speech at Harvard.
sentences.zh: 那是马克·扎克伯格在哈佛大学的毕业典礼上演讲。

sentences.en: And what he's getting at is in a world where jobs are scarce,
sentences.zh: 他的意思是，在一个工作岗位稀缺的世界里，

sentences.en: everyone will need a financial cushion.
sentences.zh: 每个人都需要一个财务缓冲垫。

sentences.en: And then, by his logic, if people don't have to worry about food and shelter,
sentences.zh: 然后，按照他的逻辑，如果人们不必担心食物和住所，

sentences.en: maybe they'd feel freer to innovate.
sentences.zh: 也许他们会觉得更有自由去创新。

sentences.en: Maybe they'd start a new company or go back to school.
sentences.zh: 也许他们会创业或者重返校园。

sentences.en: We should explore ideas like universal basic income
sentences.zh: 我们应该探讨诸如全民基本收入之类的想法

sentences.en: to make sure that everyone has a cushion to try new ideas.
sentences.zh: 以确保每个人都有一个尝试新想法的缓冲。

sentences.en: Listen to that Harvard crowd.
sentences.zh: 听听哈佛人群的反应。

sentences.en: They're just eating it up.
sentences.zh: 他们完全沉浸其中。

sentences.en: Elon Musk has also advocated for UBI,
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克也曾主张过 UBI，

sentences.en: and the startup incubator Y Combinator will soon begin its own pilot experiment
sentences.zh: 初创企业孵化器 Y Combinator 很快也将在

sentences.en: right here in Oakland to study what happens
sentences.zh: 奥克兰启动其自身的试点实验，

sentences.en: when they give a group of people a basic income.
sentences.zh: 来研究当向一群人提供基本收入时会发生什么。

sentences.en: It's actually an idea that's been around for a long time,
sentences.zh: 这其实是一个存在了很久的想法，

sentences.en: and there are many different variations on it.
sentences.zh: 并且有许多不同的变体。

sentences.en: But recently, there have been a number of experiments
sentences.zh: 但最近，世界各地出现了许多关于

sentences.en: with forms of basic income happening around the world.
sentences.zh: 各种形式基本收入的实验。

sentences.en: A nonprofit is running an experiment with UBI in Kenya,
sentences.zh: 一家非营利组织正在肯尼亚进行 UBI 实验，

sentences.en: and Ontario, Canada just launched a test in three different cities.
sentences.zh: 加拿大的安大略省刚刚在三个不同的城市启动了一项测试。

sentences.en: But this recent excitement about basic income experimentation
sentences.zh: 但最近对基本收入实验的热情

sentences.en: is largely focused on Finland.
sentences.zh: 主要集中在芬兰。

sentences.en: Finland will be the first country in the world to pilot a basic income.
sentences.zh: 芬兰将成为世界上第一个试点基本收入的国家。

sentences.en: Finland's experiment with universal basic income.
sentences.zh: 芬兰的全民基本收入实验。

sentences.en: Is it a great idea, or is it just Finnish financial folly?
sentences.zh: 这到底是个绝妙的主意，还是芬兰人的财政愚蠢行为？

sentences.en: In the beginning of 2017, the Finnish government began an experiment with a basic income.
sentences.zh: 2017 年初，芬兰政府开始了一项基本收入实验。

sentences.en: And this news about the Finland experiment was really exciting.
sentences.zh: 关于芬兰实验的消息确实令人兴奋。

sentences.en: Maybe we will learn what people will do if they can make money without work.
sentences.zh: 也许我们将了解到，如果人们不工作也能赚钱，他们会做什么。

sentences.en: Will they just hang out at home?
sentences.zh: 他们会整天闲在家里吗？

sentences.en: Will society grind to a halt?
sentences.zh: 社会会陷入停顿吗？

sentences.en: How will people find meaning in their lives, and how will they evaluate success?
sentences.zh: 人们将如何在生活中寻找意义，又将如何评估成功？

sentences.en: And that's, of course, the big question.
sentences.zh: 当然，这才是最大的问题。

sentences.en: It's the kind of the acid test of basic income,
sentences.zh: 这可以说是基本收入的终极试金石，

sentences.en: that will receiving basic income make people more or less active?
sentences.zh: 领取基本收入会让人变得更积极还是更消极？

sentences.en: Whatever the activity is, whether it's just walking around,
sentences.zh: 无论这种活动是什么，是四处闲逛，

sentences.en: or whether it's taking care of your neighborhood's kids, or applying for work.
sentences.zh: 还是照顾邻居的孩子，或者是申请工作。

sentences.en: This is Rope Moka.
sentences.zh: 这是罗佩·莫卡。

sentences.en: Founder of Demos Helsinki.
sentences.zh: 赫尔辛基 Demos 智库的创始人。

sentences.en: We are a Helsinki-based think tank.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个总部位于赫尔辛基的智库。

sentences.en: And here's what I learned, talking to Rope and other people in Finland,
sentences.zh: 以下是我在与罗佩以及芬兰其他人交谈时了解到的情况，

sentences.en: about this experiment with basic income.
sentences.zh: 关于这项基本收入实验。

sentences.en: The talk about basic income in Finland started before the understanding
sentences.zh: 芬兰关于基本收入的讨论，开始于人们尚未完全理解

sentences.en: of what the outcomes of automation would be for the employment market.
sentences.zh: 自动化会对就业市场产生什么结果之前。

sentences.en: The Finland experiment is not about robots.
sentences.zh: 芬兰的实验与机器人无关。

sentences.en: And it's not to see if people will stop working when they get free money.
sentences.zh: 也不是为了看人们在得到白给的钱后是否会停止工作。

sentences.en: The experiment is to find out if giving people basic income
sentences.zh: 实验的目的是弄清楚发放基本收入

sentences.en: will actually help them start working.
sentences.zh: 是否真的能帮助人们开始工作。

sentences.en: And this whole experiment is especially interesting to us here at 99PI,
sentences.zh: 整个实验对我们 99PI 来说尤其有趣，

sentences.en: not just for what Finland is testing, but how they are testing it.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为芬兰在测试什么，而是他们如何进行测试。

sentences.en: Finland is trying out a unique design-oriented way of thinking about government.
sentences.zh: 芬兰正在尝试一种独特的、以设计为导向的政府思维方式。

sentences.en: Rather than just rolling out laws on a massive scale,
sentences.zh: 他们不是大规模地直接推行法律，

sentences.en: they are trying to craft legislation in stages with user feedback,
sentences.zh: 而是试图通过用户反馈分阶段地制定立法，

sentences.en: like a piece of design.
sentences.zh: 就像一件设计作品一样。

sentences.en: Because every good design is made to fill a need or solve a problem.
sentences.zh: 因为每一个优秀的设计都是为了满足需求或解决问题而制作的。

sentences.en: And this is the problem.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: I hate it.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌这样。

sentences.en: To be unemployed.
sentences.zh: 失业。

sentences.en: Right now, in 2017, the unemployment rate in Finland is at 8.8%.
sentences.zh: 目前，在 2017 年，芬兰的失业率为 8.8%。

sentences.en: And that's about double the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这大约是美国

sentences.en: unemployment rate.
sentences.zh: 失业率的两倍。

sentences.en: And that rate is worse in smaller Finnish cities like Joensu.
sentences.zh: 在约恩苏等芬兰小城市，这个比率更糟。

sentences.en: Joensu is in Eastern Finland.
sentences.zh: 约恩苏位于芬兰东部。

sentences.en: Eastern Finland has always been the poorest parts of the country.
sentences.zh: 芬兰东部历来是该国最贫困的地区。

sentences.en: This is Sana Leskianen, resident of Joensu,
sentences.zh: 这是约恩苏居民萨娜·莱斯基宁，

sentences.en: which is about an hour's drive away from the Russian border.
sentences.zh: 这里距离俄罗斯边境大约有一小时的车程。

sentences.en: She's 39, and she's been unemployed for a little over two years.
sentences.zh: 她 39 岁，失业已经两年多了。

sentences.en: Unemployment has been here bigger than, say, in southern or western Finland,
sentences.zh: 这里的失业率比南部或西部芬兰等地要高，

sentences.en: because we are far from bigger cities where there are much, much, much more job opportunities.
sentences.zh: 因为我们远离大城市，那里有更多得多的就业机会。

sentences.en: Sana has a master's in history, and she worked as a researcher
sentences.zh: 萨娜拥有历史学硕士学位，她曾是一名研究员

sentences.en: until her project ran out of funding.
sentences.zh: 直到她的项目资金耗尽。

sentences.en: And all over Finland, there's been a massive decline in manufacturing work,
sentences.zh: 在整个芬兰，制造业工作一直在大幅减少，

sentences.en: ever since Nokia was crushed by Apple and Android phones.
sentences.zh: 自从诺基亚被苹果和安卓手机击垮以来。

sentences.en: Nokia's phone parts used to be made by contractors and companies all around the country.
sentences.zh: 诺基亚的手机零部件过去常常由全国各地的承包商和公司制造。

sentences.en: My mom actually worked in that factory that kind of went down when Nokia started to go down,
sentences.zh: 我妈妈其实就在那家工厂工作，随着诺基亚开始走下坡路，那家工厂也差不多倒闭了，

sentences.en: so I kind of know part of that story pretty well.
sentences.zh: 所以我对那段故事的一部分相当了解。

sentences.en: In the U.S., depending on the state, you can generally collect unemployment for about half a year
sentences.zh: 在美国，根据各州的不同，失业后你通常可以领取大约半年的失业救济金。

sentences.en: after losing a job.
sentences.zh: 在失业后。

sentences.en: In Finland, you can collect unemployment for about two years.
sentences.zh: 在芬兰，你可以领取大约两年的失业救济金。

sentences.en: And then there are different kinds of social assistances and allowances you can apply for
sentences.zh: 如果你仍然没有工作，还可以申请各种其他社会援助和津贴

sentences.en: if you still don't have a job.
sentences.zh: 如果你仍然没有工作。

sentences.en: But here's the catch.
sentences.zh: 但问题来了。

sentences.en: If you're collecting unemployment assistance in Finland,
sentences.zh: 如果你在芬兰领取失业救济金，

sentences.en: you generally cannot earn additional income,
sentences.zh: 你通常不能获得额外的收入，

sentences.en: or you risk losing those benefits.
sentences.zh: 否则你将冒着失去这些福利的风险。

sentences.en: And then you'd have to reapply, which is a massive drag.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须重新申请，这非常麻烦。

sentences.en: You cannot take, like, a part-time job,
sentences.zh: 你不能去找一份兼职工作，

sentences.en: because then you are gaining money, even though very, very little.
sentences.zh: 因为那样你就会赚钱，尽管少之又少。

sentences.en: Then it's counted against you.
sentences.zh: 然后这会被算作你的收入扣减项。

sentences.en: And so you lose that little bit of support money you were already gaining.
sentences.zh: 于是你就会失去原本已经获得的那一点点救济金。

sentences.en: So unemployed Finns don't want to risk that loss.
sentences.zh: 因此失业的芬兰人不想冒这种损失的风险。

sentences.en: They don't want to pick up temporary gig work, or part-time jobs, or freelance work.
sentences.zh: 他们不想去接零工、兼职或自由职业。

sentences.en: So it's a really, really difficult situation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常非常困难的处境。

sentences.en: This actually happened with the person we hired to record Sana.
sentences.zh: 我们雇来录制萨娜的那个人身上就发生了这种情况。

sentences.en: We asked what his rate was, and he said he couldn't charge us,
sentences.zh: 我们问他的收费标准是多少，他说他不能向我们收费，

sentences.en: because he is also unemployed and would lose part of his allowance
sentences.zh: 因为他也是失业人员，如果他接受了来自自由职业的收入，

sentences.en: if he took on money from freelance work.
sentences.zh: 就会失去部分津贴。

sentences.en: So he did it for free.
sentences.zh: 所以他是免费帮忙的。

sentences.en: Thanks, Jana.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚娜。

sentences.en: Basically, the government of Finland realized that something had to be done about this system,
sentences.zh: 基本上，芬兰政府意识到必须对这个系统做点什么，

sentences.en: that they were accidentally disincentivizing citizens from getting small jobs,
sentences.zh: 他们无意中阻止了公民去寻找小工作，

sentences.en: or maybe even starting businesses of their own.
sentences.zh: 或者甚至自己创业的积极性。

sentences.en: And these are citizens who want to work, like Sana.
sentences.zh: 而这些都是像萨娜那样想要工作的公民。

sentences.en: Being unemployed makes me feel, anyway, sort of, I don't know, unimportant.
sentences.zh: 失业让我无论如何都觉得，某种程度上，我不知道，觉得自己无足轻重。

sentences.en: I mean, doing a job would make you feel like you're doing something for, you know, a purpose,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，做一份工作会让你觉得你是在为某个目标做点什么，

sentences.en: something, but being unemployed, you're just hanging around
sentences.zh: 做点什么，但失业的话，你只是闲晃，

sentences.en: and just not being very important to anything or anybody.
sentences.zh: 对任何事和任何人都没有什么重要性。

sentences.en: So this welfare system clearly needs to be changed.
sentences.zh: 所以这个福利制度显然需要改变。

sentences.en: And this could be done in a few different ways, like with an earned income tax credit.
sentences.zh: 这可以通过几种不同的方式来完成，比如采用劳动所得税抵免。

sentences.en: But first they wanted to try out something simpler and go from there.
sentences.zh: 但他们首先想尝试更简单的方法，然后再以此为基础。

sentences.en: And this is where we get to design.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们谈到设计的地方。

sentences.en: They wanted to design and test policy in a process very similar to the way designers come up with new products.
sentences.zh: 他们希望以非常类似于设计人员构思新产品的方式来设计和测试政策。

sentences.en: You would design policies, that you would think about policies as kind of design objects or design services.
sentences.zh: 你会设计政策，将政策视为某种设计对象或设计服务。

sentences.en: And that means that you could do iteration and tests.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你可以进行迭代和测试。

sentences.en: That's Rope Mokka again, founder of the think tank Demos Helsinki.
sentences.zh: 再次听到罗佩·莫卡的声音，智库 Demos Helsinki 的创始人。

sentences.en: And the prime minister's office turned to them.
sentences.zh: 随后，总理办公室找到了他们。

sentences.en: So the prime minister's office approached us and asked that,
sentences.zh: 所以总理办公室找到了我们，并提出询问：

sentences.en: how can we employ design thinking on a national level?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何在国家层面上运用设计思维？

sentences.en: You know, how can we do like governmental level design thinking?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们怎么才能在政府层面搞设计思维？

sentences.en: Design thinking.
sentences.zh: 设计思维。

sentences.en: It goes like this.
sentences.zh: 它的流程是这样的。

sentences.en: First, there is a challenge or problem that must be solved.
sentences.zh: 首先，必须要解决一个挑战或问题。

sentences.en: Then designers express, test, and cycle.
sentences.zh: 然后，设计师进行表达、测试和循环。

sentences.en: Express.
sentences.zh: 表达。

sentences.en: That means designers come up with a few ideas and prototypes.
sentences.zh: 这意味着设计师会提出一些想法和原型。

sentences.en: TeSt.
sentences.zh: 测试。

sentences.en: They try those ideas out, maybe with a model or a sample.
sentences.zh: 他们会尝试这些想法，也许会通过模型或样本。

sentences.en: Get feedback and understand what actually happens.
sentences.zh: 获取反馈，并了解实际情况究竟如何。

sentences.en: What are the outcomes?
sentences.zh: 结果是什么？

sentences.en: And cycle.
sentences.zh: 以及循环。

sentences.en: Incorporate that feedback to make changes and revise the design.
sentences.zh: 结合这些反馈来进行修改并修正设计。

sentences.en: Then the process begins again, and again, and again, in different iterations.
sentences.zh: 接着这个过程就会一次又一次、一遍又一遍地在不同的迭代中重新开始。

sentences.en: A couple years ago, this is how the Finnish prime minister decided he wanted to design legislation.
sentences.zh: 几年前，芬兰总理就是这样决定他想要如何设计立法的。

sentences.en: Also, the prime minister, I mean, he's not a radical necessarily, right?
sentences.zh: 而且，总理，我的意思是，他未必是个激进派，对吧？

sentences.zh: 罗普表示，他们接下来应该看看，如果把基本收入发给

sentences.en: who are already employed, to see if they then quit their jobs.
sentences.zh: 已经有工作的人，会发生什么，看看他们是否会因此辞职。

sentences.en: Critics of the experiment also argue that 2,000 people is too small a sample size.
sentences.zh: 该实验的批评者还认为，2000人的样本量太小了。

sentences.en: Two Finnish economists published an op-ed in the New York Times called
sentences.zh: 两位芬兰经济学家在《纽约时报》上发表了一篇专栏文章，题为

sentences.en: Why Finland's Basic Income Experiment Isn't Working
sentences.zh: 《为什么芬兰的基本收入实验行不通》

sentences.en: and said it had the potential to incentivize people to accept low-paying and low-productivity jobs.
sentences.zh: 并表示它可能会激励人们接受低薪和低生产力的工作。

sentences.en: It's an experiment that's far from perfect.
sentences.zh: 这是一个远谈不上完美的实验。

sentences.en: But it's not supposed to be a be-all, end-all.
sentences.zh: 但它本就不是什么万灵药。

sentences.en: Ideally, it's a first draft.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下，它只是一个初稿。

sentences.en: We cannot just consider that, you know, let's give this amount to some thousands of people
sentences.zh: 我们不能仅仅认为，你知道的，把这笔钱发给几千人，

sentences.en: and then we'll know for sure there's going to be other experiments
sentences.zh: 然后我们就确信无疑了，在弄清楚如何革新社会保障之前，

sentences.en: before we can find out how to renew social security.
sentences.zh: 还会有其他的实验。

sentences.en: Basically, if this experiment is at all successful, or even if it's not,
sentences.zh: 基本上，如果这个实验哪怕有一点点成功，或者就算完全不成功，

sentences.en: it should lead to another experiment and then another and then another.
sentences.zh: 它也应该引导出另一个实验，接着又一个，再接着一个。

sentences.en: And Finland isn't just designing experiments with basic income.
sentences.zh: 而且芬兰不只是在设计基本收入实验。

sentences.en: There will be experiments for what languages to teach in schools,
sentences.zh: 学校该教什么语言、

sentences.en: how to change childcare, everything.
sentences.zh: 如何改变儿童保育等各个方面都会有实验。

sentences.en: According to their website, the experimentation office is working on 26 key projects nationally.
sentences.zh: 根据他们的网站，实验办公室在全国范围内正推进26个重点项目。

sentences.en: And slowly, hopefully, Finland will use the design process to figure out if it's possible
sentences.zh: 希望芬兰能慢慢地利用这种设计流程，来弄清楚尝试全新理念

sentences.en: or worthwhile to try radically new ideas.
sentences.zh: 是否可行或是否值得。

sentences.en: Express, test, and cycle.
sentences.zh: 表达、测试、循环。

sentences.en: Will we ever get a basic income experiment right here in the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 我们美国本土有没有可能也搞一个基本收入实验？

sentences.en: It turns out we already had one decades ago.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，几十年前我们就已经有过一个了。

sentences.en: Avery explains after the break.
sentences.zh: 埃弗里将在广告之后为您解释。

sentences.en: So a lot of people here in the United States are talking about universal basic income
sentences.zh: 所以，美国这里的很多人都在讨论全民基本收入，

sentences.en: and arguing about why it's good and why it's bad.
sentences.zh: 并争论它为什么好、为什么不好。

sentences.en: But to me, it just seems like it's just not on the table at all.
sentences.zh: 但在我看来，这似乎根本就不在讨论范围内。

sentences.en: I just feel like there's something about the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我只觉得美国有一种特性，

sentences.en: that makes it so it would never happen here.
sentences.zh: 注定了这种事永远不会在这里发生。

sentences.en: That basic income is basically something that could only be tested in Nordic welfare states.
sentences.zh: 基本收入基本上只是一种只能在北欧福利国家测试的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's the crazy thing about basic income is it's actually this very American idea.
sentences.zh: 对啊，关于基本收入最疯狂的一点是，它其实是个非常美国化的理念。

sentences.en: And it was first proposed or at least kind of first mentioned by American founding father Thomas Paine.
sentences.zh: 它最早是由美国国父托马斯·潘恩提出，或者至少可以说是他最早提及的。

sentences.en: It's like as American as apple pie.
sentences.zh: 这就像苹果派一样极其美国化。

sentences.en: And in terms of basic income experiments, we've actually been down this road before as a nation here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 说到基本收入实验，我们美国作为国家以前其实已经走过这条路了。

sentences.en: We did some studies with basic income back in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 我们在70年代做过一些关于基本收入的研究。

sentences.en: I shall ask to change the framework of government itself so we can make it again fully responsive to the needs and the wishes of the American people.
sentences.zh: 我将要求改变政府本身的架构，以便我们能让它再次全力响应美国人民的需求和愿望。

sentences.en: That's Richard Nixon.
sentences.zh: 那是理查德·尼克松。

sentences.en: Richard Nixon wanted to see if he could guarantee a family of four $1,600 a year, which is equivalent to like $10,000 today.
sentences.zh: 理查德·尼克松想看看他能否保证每个有孩子的四口之家每年有1600美元的收入，这相当于现在的1万美元左右。

sentences.en: And he hints at it in this State of the Union address.
sentences.zh: 他在这次国情咨文演讲中暗示了这一点。

sentences.en: Let us place a floor under the income of every family with children in America.
sentences.zh: 让我们为美国每一个有孩子的家庭的收入提供一个保底。

sentences.en: Let us provide the means by which more can help themselves.
sentences.zh: 让我们提供途径，让更多人能够自助。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, and then he decided to really try and do it.
sentences.zh: 然后，是的，接着他决定真正付诸行动。

sentences.en: Tens of millions of dollars were budgeted so that more than 8,500 Americans could be involved in experiments all around the country.
sentences.zh: 数千万美元的预算被批准，以便让超过8500名美国人参与到全国各地的实验中。

sentences.en: And there are a bunch of different ones.
sentences.zh: 而且有各种各样不同的实验。

sentences.en: And they all had different people running them.
sentences.zh: 它们分别由不同的人负责运营。

sentences.en: And they tested like different variations of basic income and different ideas around it.
sentences.zh: 他们测试了诸如基本收入的不同变体以及与之相关的不同理念。

sentences.en: And there was one in Seattle and one in Denver and one in Gary, Indiana and one in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 西雅图有一个，丹佛有一个，印第安纳州加里有一个，北卡罗来纳州也有一个。

sentences.en: Just like all kinds of places all over the country.
sentences.zh: 简直全国各地到处都是。

sentences.en: And so why haven't I heard of these at all?
sentences.zh: 那为什么我完全没听说过这些？

sentences.en: I have no knowledge of this.
sentences.zh: 我对此一无所知。

sentences.en: And what did they find out?
sentences.zh: 他们发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, the results were kind of screwy because it wasn't like in a perfect scientific bubble.
sentences.zh: 嗯，结果有点古怪，因为这并不像在一个完美的科学气泡里。

sentences.en: There were all these variations happening all at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所有这些变量都在同一时间发生。

sentences.en: And some of them were like different marginal tax rates and like different benefit levels and all those different kinds of stuff,
sentences.zh: 其中一些是不同的边际税率、不同的福利水平以及所有诸如此类的事情，

sentences.en: which makes it really difficult to just identify the effects because you are testing so many different versions of it.
sentences.zh: 这使得确定其效果变得非常困难，因为你测试了太多不同的版本。

sentences.en: And then actually the really big pitfall, like they did find some stuff.
sentences.zh: 然后实际上真正巨大的陷阱在于，尽管他们确实发现了一些东西。

sentences.en: But the reason that it has been pretty much discarded to the sands of time was because people started analyzing the results before all the data was in.
sentences.zh: 但它之所以几乎被历史的尘埃湮没，是因为人们在所有数据收集完之前就开始分析结果了。

sentences.en: And so there were like these rumors swirling around that people were dropping out of the workforce and just like enjoying this basic income.
sentences.zh: 于是开始流传各种谣言，说人们纷纷退出劳动力市场，仅仅是在享受这个基本收入。

sentences.en: And it wasn't actually a statistically significant trend.
sentences.zh: 这其实并不是一个具有统计学意义的趋势。

sentences.en: It was just kind of a rumor, which can sometimes be more powerful than a fact.
sentences.zh: 它只是一种谣言，而谣言有时比事实更有力量。

sentences.en: And there were also all these reports of increased separation and divorce rates.
sentences.zh: 当时还有各种关于分居和离婚率上升的报道。

sentences.en: And that was considered really scandalous and set off a lot of opposition.
sentences.zh: 这被认为极其丑恶，并引发了大量的反对声。

sentences.en: But then when the data was actually analyzed, it wasn't as large as it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 但当数据真正被分析出来时，并没有想象中那么大。

sentences.en: There weren't that many more divorces.
sentences.zh: 离婚并没有增加那么多。

sentences.en: There were a few, but this wasn't necessarily a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些，但这不一定是件坏事。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It just stopped the economic slavery of women.
sentences.zh: 它只是终结了女性在经济上的奴役状态。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And marriage.
sentences.zh: 还有婚姻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: That's not so bad.
sentences.zh: 那也没那么糟。

sentences.en: Yeah, but the American public didn't have the patience for nuance and they were like, this will be the end of the family unit.
sentences.zh: 对，但美国公众没有耐心去理解细微差别，他们觉得，这将是家庭单位的终结。

sentences.en: So we can't tolerate it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们无法容忍。

sentences.en: And it's all just because like they started chatting about it before they had their actual results.
sentences.zh: 这一切都只是因为他们在拿到实际结果之前就开始议论纷纷了。

sentences.en: Yeah, before they had the numbers.
sentences.zh: 没错，在拿到具体数字之前。

sentences.en: You know, it was kind of disregarded before we really had a chance to fully analyze the data.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在我们真正有机会全面分析数据之前，它就被忽视了。

sentences.en: I think that's certainly a challenge that we're keeping in mind.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是我们铭记在心的一个挑战。

sentences.en: This is Elizabeth Rhodes, and she is the research director of a basic income study that is happening at Y Combinator Research,
sentences.zh: 这是伊丽莎白·罗兹，她是Y Combinator研究实验室正在进行的一项基本收入研究的研究总监，

sentences.en: which is a nonprofit research lab created by a startup accelerator called Y Combinator.
sentences.zh: 该实验室是由一家名为Y Combinator的初创企业加速器创建的非营利研究实验室。

sentences.en: And she works like right down the street.
sentences.zh: 她工作的地点就在这条街的尽头。

sentences.en: Yeah, right here.
sentences.zh: 对，就在这儿。

sentences.en: From our office.
sentences.zh: 离我们的办公室不远。

sentences.en: And she is helping to launch a basic income experiment nearby here in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 她正在协助在附近的奥克兰启动一项基本收入实验。

sentences.en: We are in the process of, we're doing sort of a pre-pilot,
sentences.zh: 我们目前正在进行的是一种预先试点，

sentences.en: a small group to sort of test some of the logistics and work through some of the questions around that and preparing for a larger randomized control trial that we hope to launch next year.
sentences.zh: 通过一个小群体来测试一些后勤工作，并解决其中的一些问题，为我们希望在明年启动的更大规模的随机对照试验做准备。

sentences.en: After that local test, they want to really expand it.
sentences.zh: 在那个本地测试之后，他们希望真正扩大规模。

sentences.en: We're actually looking to do two U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上正着眼于在全美两个州

sentences.en: states and in broader regions within two states.
sentences.zh: 以及两个州内的更广泛区域开展研究。

sentences.en: They have definitely learned from these early experiments to start small, expand slowly, and to not promise too much because, you know,
sentences.zh: 他们绝对从这些早期实验中吸取了教训：小规模起步，缓慢扩张，不要承诺太多，因为，你知道的，

sentences.en: they want to wait for this experiment to fully play out.
sentences.zh: 他们想等待这个实验完全发挥作用。

sentences.en: Unlike Finland, they are definitely doing this because of the robots and because they're based here in the Bay Area, which is like home of the gig economy.
sentences.zh: 与芬兰不同，他们绝对是因为机器人而这样做，而且他们总部设在这里的湾区，这里可以说是零工经济的发源地。

sentences.en: And just want to see if this will make people happy in an era where robots take over all of our jobs.
sentences.zh: 并且只是想看看在机器人接管我们所有工作的一个时代里，这能否让人快乐。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or jobs are not like jobs they are today.
sentences.zh: 或者说工作不再是如今这种工作。

sentences.en: Right, right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对。

sentences.en: They're gig jobs.
sentences.zh: 它们是零工。

sentences.en: And therefore, having a basic income would ameliorate a kind of economy that a lot of the Silicon Valley is helping to create.
sentences.zh: 因此，拥有基本收入将改善许多硅谷正在帮助创造的那种经济形态。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: But then on the other side of it, like they're a startup accelerator.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，他们是一个初创企业加速器。

sentences.en: Like they help businesses grow.
sentences.zh: 就像他们帮助企业成长一样。

sentences.en: And they're like, if this is what it takes, if they need a basic income in order to, you know, innovate capital I, like, let's see if it'll work.
sentences.zh: 他们会想，如果这就是代价，如果他们需要基本收入来，你知道的，进行大写的“创新”，好吧，让我们看看它是否行得通。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 原来如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, and they just want to make sure that they don't set expectations too high.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们只是想确保不要把期望值拉得太高。

sentences.en: The study is going to run, you know, for several years.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这项研究将进行好几年。

sentences.en: And so I don't expect to see, you know, changes overnight in any way.
sentences.zh: 所以我不指望能看到，你知道的，有什么一夜之间的改变。

sentences.en: And so I think we really need to give it time.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为我们真的需要给它时间。

sentences.en: So in doing this research about basic income, I've come across a thousand polarizing think pieces that are either like, UBI is a great idea and we should do this right now.
sentences.zh: 所以在做关于基本收入的这项研究时，我遇到了成千上万两极分化的深度文章，它们要么说，UBI是个绝佳的主意，我们现在就该这么做。

sentences.en: Or like, this is a terrible idea and we need to stop it.
sentences.zh: 要么就说，这是个糟糕透顶的主意，必须叫停。

sentences.en: But realistically, it's going to be years before we know what we can learn from this privatized American experiment or from the Finnish experiment, for that matter.
sentences.zh: 但现实点说，还要过好几年，我们才知道能从这个私有化的美国实验或芬兰实验中学到什么。

sentences.en: Because most of the arguments we're having about basic income at this point in time, in all of basic income's many different definitions and variations,
sentences.zh: 因为我们在现阶段关于基本收入的大多数争论，在基本收入的许多不同定义和变体中，

sentences.en: it's all based in speculation.
sentences.zh: 全都基于猜测。

sentences.en: We're having a debate without data and no one has solid answers yet about what basic income would mean for the national tax code or inflation or unemployment rates or the economy or the robots or our happiness and well-being.
sentences.zh: 我们正在进行一场没有数据的辩论，对于基本收入对国家税收、通货膨胀、失业率、经济、机器人或是我们的幸福感究竟意味着什么，还没有人能给出确切的答案。

sentences.en: And right now, all we know is that different experimenters all around the world are trying to figure out some answers.
sentences.zh: 而现在，我们所知道的只是世界各地的不同实验者正在努力寻找一些答案。

sentences.en: We just don't know them yet.
sentences.zh: 只是我们目前还不知道答案。

sentences.en: So this is going to end like all radio stories end, which is time will tell.
sentences.zh: 所以这将像所有的广播故事一样结束，那就是时间会证明一切。

sentences.en: Only time will tell.
sentences.zh: 只有时间会证明一切。

sentences.en: But for now, time will tell.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，时间会证明一切。
